text:
Maya: FYI I rolled the reranker v2-quant to staging (model: ranky-v2-int8). Holdout run shows NDCG -2.7% relative to fp16, MRR -1.2%. Short queries seem hit hardest. Anyone else seeing priming-like errors?
Liam: :eyes: saw a drop too in my slice. Short queries (<6 tokens) top1 flips a lot. suspect priming from candidate concatenation order.
Sara: ran a quick diff. Many failure cases have extra '###' separators in candidate text that the tokenizer treats as priming. Uploading examples.
eval-bot: per-slice diffs uploaded: https://internal/ephemeral/3781234560/diffs.csv
Maya: can you paste one example?
Liam: Query: 'how to reset router' Candidate A (gold): 'Answer: factory reset steps...' Candidate B (pred): 'See also: troubleshooting ### factory reset...' The 'See also' prefix pushes candidate B up with int8.
Sara: interesting — quant seems to change tokenization alignment around punctuation, shifting score differences.
Devon: ops note: quant backend is `hybrid-int8` with KVpack enabled on the staging pool. No other infra changes.
Maya: trying a quick change: remove candidate prefixing (the 'See also' template) and rerun holdout.
Maya: here's the helper I used to normalize candidates:
```python
def canonicalize(c):
    return re.sub(r'\s+###\s+', ' - ', c).strip()
```
Liam: can we also try disabling prefix tokens at scoring time? config flag `priming_tokens:false` in scorer.yaml
Sara: +1. Also suggest run ablation: (A) normalize separators, (B) priming_tokens:false, (C) both.
Maya: plan: kick off 3 jobs on holdout. Will tag runs with experiment ids. ETA ~30m per job.
deploybot: deployment triggered: staging/rankers/ranky-v2-int8 @3781234580
eval-bot: started job bulk-holdout-3781234560-A at 3781234585; monitor: https://internal/jobs/3781234560/A
Liam: attaching two short failing cases inline:
1) Query: 'vpn set up' Cand1: 'See also: VPN setup guide...' Cand2: 'Quick steps: install client...' -> int8 prefers Cand1
2) Query: 'reset printer' Cand1: 'Factory reset steps' Cand2: 'Printer settings menu' -> tie jitter
Sara: note: NDCG hit concentrated in <8 token queries and docs with <100 chars. Maybe quantized attention kernels lose granularity for small contexts.
Maya: if ablations fix it we promote. if not, rollback to fp16 and open a quant bug.
Devon: letting you know staging GPUs will be rebooted for mem defrag in 10m, might interrupt runs.
Maya: thanks — will prioritize durability: saving current seeds and rerun when stable.
Liam: tracked a quick offline metric: enabling `priming_tokens:false` recovered NDCG by ~1.8% but not full. Combined with separator normalization recovers ~2.9%.
Sara: can you push diff? curious if MRR also recovers.
Liam: pasted command to run local eval:
`python eval/holdout_run.py --model ranky-v2-int8 --holdout s1 --norm-sep --no-priming`
Maya: nice. OK I'll run all three then report numbers.
Maya: thanks team. I'll post final summary and arch ticket if we need kernel fallback.
